hypothesis_text: IRF7 in B cells prevent response to seasonal influenza vaccine
population: healthy human recipients of seasonal influenza vaccination

possible_measurements: IRF7 transcript abundance in sorted B cells (RNA-seq or microarray)
IRF7 expression in B cell clusters from single-cell RNA-seq of PBMC
IRF7 module or interferon-regulatory-factor signature score in bulk PBMC/whole blood deconvolved to B cells
IRF7 protein level by flow cytometry or CyTOF in CD19+ cells

outcome.name: Influenza vaccine immunogenicity
possible_measurements: hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) titer at day 28 relative to day 0
influenza-specific IgG by ELISA or multiplex assay
day 7 plasmablast frequency by flow cytometry

required_data: gene expression data from B cells or from PBMC/whole blood with B cell resolution
influenza-specific antibody titers (HAI, microneutralization, or ELISA) post-vaccination
subject-level identifiers linking transcriptomics to antibody outcomes

scientific_criteria.description: Participants received a seasonal influenza vaccine (inactivated or live attenuated).
Study includes transcriptomic or proteomic measurement from which IRF7 levels could be extracted (RNA-seq, microarray, scRNA-seq, CyTOF/flow with IRF7 or interferon markers).
Expression data derive from sorted B cells, single-cell data containing B cells, or bulk blood samples amenable to B cell deconvolution.
Study measures influenza-specific antibody response (HAI, microneutralization, or ELISA titers) after vaccination.
Samples span at least a pre-vaccination or early post-vaccination timepoint for expression and a post-vaccination timepoint (approximately day 21-28 or later) for antibody titer.
Expression measurements and antibody titers can be linked to the same individual participant via shared subject identifiers.
Study includes enough vaccinated participants with both expression and titer data to support an association analysis (roughly 20 or more).

operational_criteria.description: Study data files (expression matrices and lab results) are publicly downloadable from ImmPort or a linked repository.
Subject, timepoint, and biosample annotations are present and sufficient to align assays.
Expression data are provided at gene level or can be mapped to gene symbols including IRF7.

primary_statistical_test.example_model: log2_HAI_fold_change ~ B_cell_IRF7_expression + baseline_HAI_titer + age + sex + study/batch

recommended_analysis.predictor: IRF7 expression in B cells (sorted B cell RNA, B cell cluster pseudobulk from scRNA-seq, or deconvolved B cell signal) at pre-vaccination or early post-vaccination
recommended_analysis.outcome: log2 fold change in influenza HAI titer from day 0 to day 28 (or maximum strain-specific fold change)
recommended_analysis.model: log2_HAI_fold_change ~ B_cell_IRF7_expression + baseline_HAI_titer + age + sex + study/batch
